scope: independent root audit of the paired resultant, cluster radical, isolated packing, threshold constant, shifted-norm comparison, method-class scope, replay, and canonical dependencies

checks.root_repairs: Repaired three malformed TeX expressions, changed the classification from the misleading word capacity-reduction to capacity-criterion, repinned the checker to canonical Item 391, regenerated all certificates, and canonicalized the replay path. No proved bound changed.

mathematical_audit.resultant: Pairing the ordered root factors gives (2d)^n times the product over unordered pairs of ((2d)^2-(q-p)^2). Its zeros are exactly the 2d gaps and its nonzero sign depends on the unknown comparison of all gaps with 2d.
mathematical_audit.cluster_radical: The radical over both endpoint gcds counts every and only actual collision prime having another actual collision prime within numerical distance 2D, once regardless of multiplicity.
mathematical_audit.master_inequality: The complementary prime roots are separated by more than 2D inside an interval of length (M-9)/6. Packing gives the isolated contribution and, for D asymptotic to c log M, the exact normalized term 1/(72c).
mathematical_audit.admission_threshold: Comparing the master inequality with 1/36 yields the necessary sufficient target log C <= ((2c-1)/(12c)-epsilon)M; at c=1 this is strictly below M/12.
mathematical_audit.norm_height: For each root p, the shifted factors are p(1 plus or minus 2d/p). Elementary logarithmic inequalities and n<=M/(6log M)+o(M/log M) give the uniform exp(plus or minus c/4+o(1)) comparison.
mathematical_audit.no_go_scope: Ordinary gcd height, generic resultant height/sign, and unlocalized multiplication retain the unknown radical at essentially its original height. This does not exclude gate-specific factorization, average-gcd, monodromy, or direct arithmetic input.
